mode: Four reference edits and one new render, all transparent_background=true. No API or CLI image generation.
artDirection: Preserve the accepted subjects, card composition and palette. Improve precise soft dimensional geometry, matte material edges and gentle upper-left light. No new text, logos or narrative.

edgeCleanup.authorization: The user explicitly approved local image tooling: Yes, clean the edges.
edgeCleanup.tool: Sharp 0.35.5 for alpha-mask morphology; pngjs preserves source RGB bytes; cwebp converts final assets.
recipe: Read the generated PNG without modifying RGB.
Threshold source alpha at 180 to identify the object mask.
Use four-connected components and discard components smaller than 300 pixels.
Apply median(9), erode(3), dilate(2), then blur(0.7) to the one-channel mask.
Set output alpha to min(original alpha, processed mask alpha). This removes fringe without increasing opacity or changing RGB.
edgeCleanup.alpha: Preserved losslessly during WebP encoding; verified byte-for-byte against the cleaned PNG alpha channel.
